claude.note: Tiers are listed lightest first. Every Claude tier runs at xhigh effort, the same as Opus: the claude CLI accepts it for Haiku, Sonnet and Opus, and a lighter model should not also lose effort.

light.use: mechanical and lookup work: renames, formatting, simple searches and summaries, gathering facts from given files

standard.use: well-specified, bounded work: small changes to 1 to 5 files with clear done criteria, tests for existing behavior, docs, reviews of small diffs

complex.use: hard, ambiguous, cross-cutting or high-risk work, every pull-request babysitter, and the default when unsure or without --tier

standard.use: well-specified, bounded work; the default Codex tier

complex.use: ambiguous, cross-cutting, or high-risk work, or a standard-tier attempt that failed
